summary: Li works on spatial intelligence and argues that AI should augment people, with governance based on science and guardrails on its applications.

statements.quote: The goal of building any technology, AI included, should be bettering human lives and society.
As one of the scientists who helped usher in the era of modern AI, my motivation has always been clear: AI must augment human capability, not replace it.
Spatial intelligence will transform how we create and interact with real and virtual worlds—revolutionizing storytelling, creativity, robotics, scientific discovery, and beyond.
I really think a pragmatic approach that focuses on applications and ensuring a guardrail for safe deliverance of this technology is a good starting point.
One thing that I think we should do is base all this on science, not science fiction.
